dialogues.speaker: Arlecchino
dialogues.text: The enemies we face are of a lowly breed. Deal with them however you see fit.

dialogues.speaker: Arlecchino
dialogues.text: But do not get complacent. You should expect to fend for yourself, as I am not in the habit of coming to other people's rescue.

dialogues.speaker: Arlecchino
dialogues.text: If you do encounter a foe for whom you are no match, simply make yourself scarce, and I shall deal with it in due course.
